`agridata_sample.csv` is a small extract of real rows from https://github.com/k0rn/India_Agri_Data
(CC0-1.0): Punjab (Ludhiana, Bhatinda, Mansha), Kerala (Kozhikode coconut/rice/banana), Assam
(Nagaon jute/rice) and Sikkim (East). It keeps the source's original spellings and units so the
tests catch real-data problems (bales, nuts, old district names) that invented data would miss.
